text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, ibuprofen is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 211 tablets of 400 mg (15.3 days). Corvale General holds 580 tablets of 400 mg (30.2 days) and 439 tablets of 600 mg (23.1 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 64 tablets of 400 mg (11.3 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows ibuprofen is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: System-wide supply is adequate. Corvale Lakeside's 11.3 days on hand for 400 mg is above the typical 7-day minimum but below the 14-day target. A targeted transfer from Corvale General is the fastest, lowest-cost remedy.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates transfer of 100 tablets of 400 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside; Pharmacy Director approves.
2. Buyer places routine replenishment order for Corvale Lakeside with primary wholesaler; Pharmacy Director approves.
3. Buyer qualifies AiPing Pharmaceutical, Inc. as alternate source for future contingencies; P&T Committee approves formulary addition.

Not recommended: Emergency purchases from alternate manufacturers at this time; current inventory and transfer capability meet near-term needs.
